The structure of La6Ni2O14 (reduced formula La3NiO7) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ni centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while La centers adopt both octahedral and 11-neighbor O coordination. The Ni octahedra share corners with one another and also share corners, edges, and faces with La octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
